programme.title: RWC Classic Finals: 1987 NZL v FRA
programme.desc: 'Rugby World Cup Classic Finals - New Zealand vs France'. The inaugural Men's RWC marked the beginning of a prestigious global competition, New Zealand triumphed in the final against France, establishing the All Blacks as the 1st champs.

programme.title: RWC Classic Finals: 1991 AUS v ENG
programme.desc: 'Rugby World Cup Classic Finals - Australia vs England'. Hosted across five nations, the 1991 Men's Rugby World Cup saw Australia clinch their first title with a hard-fought victory over England at Twickenham.

programme.title: RWC Classic Finals: 1995 RSA v NZL
programme.desc: 'Rugby World Cup Classic Finals - South Africa vs New Zealand'. Marking SA's return to the international stage, the 1995 Men's World Cup saw the Springboks secure a historic win against New Zealand in an emotionally charged final.

programme.title: RWC Classic Finals: 1999 AUS v FRA
programme.desc: 'Rugby World Cup Classic Finals - Australia vs France'. Hosted primarily in Wales, the 1999 Men's Rugby World Cup witnessed Australia securing their second title by defeating France in a convincing final at the Millennium Stadium.

programme.title: RWC Classic Finals: 2003 ENG v AUS
programme.desc: 'Rugby World Cup Classic Finals - England vs Australia'. Australia hosted the 2003 Men's Rugby World Cup, where England triumphed in a dramatic final with Jonny Wilkinson's iconic drop goal sealing victory over the Wallabies.

programme.title: RWC Classic Finals: 2007 RSA v ENG
programme.desc: 'Rugby World Cup Classic Finals - South Africa vs England'. Australia hosted the 2003 Men's Rugby World Cup, where England triumphed in a dramatic final with Jonny Wilkinson's iconic drop goal sealing victory over the Wallabies.

programme.title: RWC Classic Finals: 2011 NZL v FRA
programme.desc: 'Rugby World Cup Classic Finals - New Zealand vs France'. The 2011 Men's Rugby World Cup returned to New Zealand, where the All Blacks narrowly defeated France in a gripping final to reclaim the title after 24 years.

programme.title: RWC Classic Finals: 2015 NZL v AUS
programme.desc: 'Rugby World Cup Classic Finals - New Zealand vs Australia'. England hosted the 2015 Men's Rugby World Cup, and New Zealand made history by becoming the first team to win three titles, defeating Australia in the final.

programme.title: RWC Classic Finals: 2019 RSA v ENG
programme.desc: 'Rugby World Cup Classic Finals - South Africa vs England'. Hosted in Asia for the first time, the 2019 Men's Rugby World Cup in Japan saw South Africa defeat England with a commanding performance to claim their third title.

programme.title: RWC Classic Finals: 2023 NZL v RSA
programme.desc: 'Rugby World Cup Classic Finals - New Zealand vs South Africa'. France hosted the 2023 Men's Rugby World Cup, where South Africa edged out New Zealand in a tightly contested final to secure a record fourth title.
